text: その　くやしさこそが！

structure.jp: その　くやしさこそが！

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ after a word singles it out strongly: this and nothing else. くやしさこそ = 'that very frustration'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ in place of the final い turns a describing word into the name of the feeling. くやしい is 'frustrating', so くやしさ = 'frustration'.
